The '''''Croc of Gold''''' was a small [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] purchased by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Devon Fuller]]. Despite his shady past, Fuller used the ''Croc of Gold'' to deal in legal goods, although he was not very successful until he met [[Owen Sareth]], an [[operative]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who possessed an acumen for business that Fuller lacked.<ref name="GG9" />

Fuller and Sareth became friends and eventually Fuller joined the Rebellion in their [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Fuller continued to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] the ''Croc of Gold'' for the Rebels, until it was wrecked by Imperial forces near [[Tashtor Seneca]],<ref name="GG9" /> sometime before the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] was [[Battle of Endor/Legends|destroyed]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="date" /> Fuller escaped the freighter's destruction and gained ownership of [[Freebooter|another starship]] that eventually met a similar fate.<ref name="GG9" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Croc of Gold'' was mentioned in the [[1993]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'', written by [[Simon Smith]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]] for [[West End Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG9" />
